title: Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon 2026 Review: Mindanao's Insurer-Backed Road Race
seo_title: Singlife CDO Marathon 2026 Review | Cagayan de Oro Philippines
meta_description: The Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon 2026: December 13 in CDO, Philippines. Full marathon and half marathon with registration open — Mindanao's flagship road race reviewed.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 in Cagayan de Oro — Mindanao's 'City of Golden Friendship' — this Singlife-backed marathon offers full and half distances with registration already open. Here's what to expect from one of the Philippines' key regional marathons.
verdict: The Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon brings a major insurance-brand sponsorship to one of Mindanao's most important running events. Full and half marathon distances keep it focused, and the December date in CDO offers dry-season conditions in a city known for its adventure-tourism infrastructure — white-water rafting, zip-lining, and the gateway to northern Mindanao's highlands. Registration is open, and the Singlife backing gives the event commercial credibility. Suits runners who want a Philippine marathon beyond the Manila–Cebu corridor with brand-backed production values.

sections.heading: The Destination: Cagayan de Oro
paragraphs: CDO is northern Mindanao's largest city and a hub for adventure tourism — white-water rafting on the Cagayan River, zip-lines, and the cool highlands of Bukidnon a short drive away. [1] December is dry-season in the region, with manageable temperatures and lower humidity than the mid-year months. For runners, CDO offers a combination of urban infrastructure and outdoor-recovery options that few other Philippine cities match.

sections.heading: The Race: Singlife-Backed
paragraphs: Singlife's sponsorship gives the event a level of commercial backing that regional Philippine races rarely enjoy — expect quality medals, branded race tees, and well-stocked aid stations. [1] Two distances (full marathon 42.195km and half marathon 21.1km) keep it focused on distance running. Registration is open, making this a bookable option for December 2026.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a Philippine marathon in a genuine adventure destination with brand-backed production and open registration, the Singlife CDO Marathon is worth booking. The 2026 edition is set for 13 December in Cagayan de Oro. [1]
